_readme: RECORDS MANIFEST — index of public records, source documents, and authorities behind the stormwater plan. This is a transparency aid, not a legal repository; all listed items are public records (FL Ch. 119) and contain no PII. Schema per row: {id, title, date (ISO8601 date), type, sourceAuthority, sourceUrl, confidence:'verified'|'inferred', note}. confidence 'verified' = we have a direct, checkable source (URL/document) confirming title/date/scope; confidence 'inferred' = referenced from secondary discussion or plan narrative and NOT yet confirmed against a primary source — always flag inferred rows with a '[UNVERIFIED]' note describing what still needs confirmation. TO EDIT: edit on GitHub → PR → Vercel Preview → merge to prod. Prefer exact citations (statute §, grant ID, resolution number). Never add per-property dollar amounts. Use 'special assessment', never 'tax'.

records.title: FS § 197.3632 — Uniform method for collection of non-ad-valorem assessments
records.note: Governs the intent-resolution (before Jan 1), notice, hearing, and Sep 15 roll-certification steps the plan relies on. Date reflects the current statutory version; confirm the effective year applicable to program adoption.

records.title: FS § 403.0893 — Stormwater funding; dedicated funds and assessments
records.note: Statutory authority for local stormwater management utilities/assessments. Confirm citation applicability to Walton County's chosen funding vehicle.

records.title: Walton County Meetings & Agendas portal
records.note: Primary source for BCC agendas, minutes, and meeting cadence (2nd & 4th Tuesday, 4:00 PM Central). Date is the last-reviewed date, not a document date.
